parameters.content:
## TBW Instagram v3 — TEST SAFELY BEFORE DASHBOARD CUTOVER
1. Publish Timer v3 then Main v3. Unpublish old IG-only v1/v2 listeners. Never unpublish a combined V4 if it still handles live WhatsApp; redirect its Instagram Bridge instead.
2. New bridge endpoint: /webhook/tbw-ig-simple-v3-events (v2 alias supported; V4 is intentionally NOT aliased to protect WhatsApp). Only one listener per path.
3. DM language selection supports both Meta payload and plain text `English` / 1–4 (Instagram desktop).
4. Four categories → six services each → WhatsApp prefilled link and buttons. No AI.
5. For Reels: edit `IG - Test Reel Rule (OFF by default)` with exact Reel media ID; enable for test ONLY; then OFF and use dashboard `/api/instagram/comment-check`.
6. Public comment reply requires an explicitly enabled per-Reel rule (dashboard field public_reply_enabled), and private reply requires reply_text.
7. One private reply per comment, within seven days; no follow-up DMs until user messages.
8. 3m nudge once; 20m silent close. Timers only on successful DM response.
9. Personal WhatsApp alert is best-effort due to Meta 24h/template restrictions. No unattended replay on DNS timeout.
10. Actual dashboard `/comment-check` backend must return fields described in SETUP. Its UI alone cannot guarantee the endpoint returns public reply settings.
11. Test with personal Instagram account. NEVER publish v3 alongside old IG listeners.

parameters.content:
## Event-driven IG session timer — no cron!
Every successfully sent customer DM starts this timer by localhost HTTP. Wait 3 minutes → call Main workflow to nudge ONLY if no new customer message. Wait another 17 minutes → call Main to close session SILENTLY if still inactive. Old timer callbacks are ignored by session ID + latest inbound timestamp. No messages on every minute. This requires BOTH Main & Timer published and existing IG old listeners unpublished.
